media.plainText: Cleared for published DP on IFR flight plan. After takeoff "climb and maintain FL350..."
Climb immediately to FL350 and proceed via direct flight to the DP transition point
On a flight from NAS Meridian to Montgomery Regional, prior to commencing a HI ILS approach, tune and ID NAVAIDS. Which TACAN should be tuned and IDed
Channel 97 (MXF)
When flight planning, an airport designated "official business only"
Be designated as an alternate on an IFR flight plan
For all flights in a jet, 3710 requires fuel from takeoff to landing plus a reserve of:
10%, but not less than that required for 20 minutes flight at max endurance at 10,000 MSL
Which of the following are true concerning HI-TACAN RWY 19L approach chart to NAS Meridian?
You must maintain 3000 ft between the 328 and 358 radials
With all NAVAIDs and facilities operating, takeoff mins for a standard instrument pilot departing runway 9 at NAS Jax would be
When on an IFR flight plan and cleared to an intermediate point not in a filed route, short of filed destination, should not accept the clearance without first obtaining
Expect further routing
On a missed approach at NAS Meridian you decide to go to your alternate, Maxwell AFB. Cat C mins for an ILS RWY 15 circle to land RWY 33 approach will be:

You are in the GCA box pattern, within 25 nm of the field in IMC, when comms are lost. From here, intercept a published instrument approach maintaining ____ until established on a segment of the approach
The highest of your last assigned or published MSA
Your destination is forecasting 800-1/2 . Published approach procedures (NW winds) at alternate, Columbus AFB, lowest weather conditions for filing would be ____. ILS and ALS inop.
To be cleared for a visual approach, must report to approach control that you have field or interval in sight and weather must be reported as
1000-3 or greater
Inadvertent IMC and lose sight of the runway while circle to land
Execute missed approach for the original approach procedure
Minimum forecast weather needed to plan for NAS Meridian (RWY 01L) as your destination? Maxwell AFB is alternate and forecasting 900-3. NAS Meridian NOTAMS: GCA O/S ALL, ALS O/S 01L.
A LOC transmitter has a range of ___ nm within 10* of centerline and ____ nm within 35* of centerline.
Reading back an ATC clearance implies acceptance of the clearance unless ___
You first state refusal and reasons
Executing the ILS RWY 15 approach into Maxwell AFB, you should be at ___ AGL when crossing the runway threshold.
50 feet
When not in radar contact, the following additional reports should be made to ATC or FSS facilities without a specific ATC request (when not in radar contact):
All of the above
ID the true statement concerning DPs and/or STARs:
DPs are designed to provide transition from the airfield to the appropriate enroute structure, and their use on the DD-175 is encouraged but not mandatory
Yor MDA for the Maxwell AFB TACAN RWY 15 approach (with ALS) is published as
500 ft MSL
Takeoff is allowed if the current weather at the departure airport is at least ___ and meets or exceeds the published precision mins for the runway in use
While on the Maxwell AFB TACAN RWY 15 approach, when would you execute a missed approach if you did not have the runway in sight?
At 1.5 DME from the TACAN
Flying on J2 between Crestview and Seminole you would change your TACAN to Ch 122 when you are at the CEW 088/___
80 DME
Select the choice that best describes the service volume characteristics of an (L) VOR navigational system. Range ______
Up to and including 18000 ft AGL out to 40 nm
At Maxwell AFB, the PAPI system availability will be:
Denoted in the IFR Supp by a "50" under lighting
The star next to the ATIS found in the upper left corner of the TACAN approaches to Maxwell AFB denotes that:
The ATIS operates on a noncontinuous basis
Of the following situations, the one which does not require a voice report (NOT RVSM) is:
Reaching a newly assigned altitude
You request a PAR approach to RWY 19L at NAS Meridian. Your DA in a single piloted aircraft for an approach to that runway would be:
517 ft MSL
The theory and operating characteristics of a GPS system are:
GPS uses passive receivers and triangulation computations from signals received from at least 4 satellites to determine lat, long, and vertical position
Enroute to NAS Meridian, you listen to ATIS, which gives airport info, but no weather info. You know that Meridian is ____
VFR, with a ceiling of at least 6000 ft and better than 5 miles visibility
Planning for a flight from NAS Jax to Birmingham, for filing purposes, based on the info above, what is the lowest weather mins required at Columbus?
When planning for a direct flight between two high NAVAIDs in the jet route structure, do not exceed the normal anticipated interference free reception range of each NAVAID which is ___
130 NM
Planning on a flight from NAS Jax to BAM
ETA 1500Z and alt of Columbus AFB
Your filed destination is NMM with arrived weather best to be 300-1. The alternate field has PAR and TCN . The approach minimum weather at the alternate would be
TCN plus 300-1
If you experience lost comms enroute in IMC, you should maintain:
The last assigned altitude but no lower than the MEA for each route segment
You are halfway to filed destination on extended IFR flight plan at FL290. Radio fails, in VMC and destination has marginal weather. If you determine you can maintain VMC in flight
Squawk 7600, maintain VMC, and something traffic pattern and land at a suitable airport
Which publication would provide information on preferred IFR routing?
FLIP AP/1
You are cleared to the PIGMY IAF @ NMM with EFC 1610Z. Presently at or above 14000 ft, enroute you experience radio failure so as to depart PIGMY at 1610Z or after descend and commence approach.
Idk thats all that was written
30 miles SE of MGM at FL350 you are directed to change frequency but are unable on assigned frequency. Attempt to contact center on
319.1 CATC alt subdivided
For a cancelled DP to be reinstated ATC must:
Indicate the portion of the DP routing that still applies and reinstated altitude restrictions
PAR pickup question lost comm.
Pass through highest initiated penetration altitude of the IAFs at the airport.
High altitude NAVAID
130 NM
